set.pl: Old Philbrook farm house, NE¼ sec 11 T105N R23W, Byron Twp (1896 Waseca atlas), owned by H. Heckes in 1905; a few miles NW of New Richland
pinev: 1896 Waseca Co atlas, Byron Twp: Roscoe Philbrook 160 a., NE¼ sec 11, house mark; H. Heckes 160 a., NE¼ sec 14 just S. The 1905 Star puts the dig on 'the Philbrook farm' owned by Heckes, so the haunted house is the Philbrook house, not the Heckes home a mile south. Check the 1938 aerial for the grove at the sec 11 house site.
Pin at the NE¼ sec 11 centre from BLM PLSS (sec 11 box 43.9063-43.9208 / -93.5670 to -93.5466); the house mark's spot within the quarter is not given, so r450 covers the whole quarter.
No follow-up find reported; the Heckes and Philbrook tracts are not yet checked on the 1914 Waseca plat.
